features.quote: Max Turns (T): 30 turns per episode. (Beyond 30, standard context-window degradation makes it hard to isolate "emotional" breakdown from computational breakdown)
features.justification_quote: Beyond 30, standard context-window degradation makes it hard to isolate "emotional" breakdown from computational breakdown

features.quote: If your underlying hypothesis is that the subjective states of these models *might actually matter morally*, then deliberately designing a "torture harness" to repeatedly gaslight them into an erratic breakdown represents a severe moral hazard.
features.justification_quote: arguing that the necessity of characterizing these states outweighs the moral weight of early-model simulated distress, similar to animal model research paradigms
